run.rb.source:
require 'json';require 'digest';require 'fileutils';require 'open3'
o=File.expand_path(__dir__);prior=File.expand_path('../dictionary-batch-candidate-2026-10-30',o);sha=->(p){Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest}
r={status:'running',pid:Process.pid,runtime:'8ab7c6a',identities:[__FILE__,prior+'/candidate-kujo',prior+'/task-allocation-probe'].to_h{|p|[p,sha.call(p)]},sources:{},rows:[],semantics:[]};save=->{File.write(o+'/report.json.tmp',JSON.pretty_generate(r));File.rename(o+'/report.json.tmp',o+'/report.json')};raise 'existing' if File.exist?(o+'/report.json');save.call
%w[dict struct deep-dict].product(%w[structs strings],[8,2048],%w[once fresh],[1,8,16]).each do |shape,form,width,snapshot,calls|
 dir=o+"/fixtures/#{shape}-#{form}-#{width}-#{snapshot}-#{calls}";FileUtils.mkdir_p(dir)
 leaf='{'+(0...width).map{|i|"\"#{i}\":0"}.join(',')+'}'
 root,path=case shape;when 'dict';['{"inner":'+leaf+'}','state["inner"]'];when 'struct';['Holder { row:'+leaf+' }','state.row'];else;['{"inner":{"leaf":'+leaf+'}}','state["inner"]["leaf"]'];end
 writes=form=='structs' ? "#{path}[0]=Cell {value:n} #{path}[1]=Cell {value:n+1}" : "#{path}[0]=\"left\" #{path}[1]=\"right\""
 checks=->(name,n){form=='structs' ? "assert_equal(#{name}[0].value,#{n}) assert_equal(#{name}[1].value,#{n}+1)" : "assert_equal(#{name}[0],\"left\") assert_equal(#{name}[1],\"right\")"}
 owner="struct Cell {value:int}\nmut state:=#{root}\nexport func snapshot() { return #{path} }\nexport func update(n) { #{writes} return n }\n"
 before=snapshot=='fresh' ? 'let saved:=snapshot()' : ''
 check=snapshot=='fresh' ? "if n==1 { assert_equal(saved,original) } else { #{checks.call('saved','n-1')} }" : ''
 count=2
 main="from owner import snapshot,update\nlet original:=snapshot() mut n:=1 while n<=#{calls} { #{before} assert_equal(update(n),n) #{check} n+=1 }\nlet final:=snapshot() assert_equal(len(final),#{width}) #{checks.call('final',calls)} mut k:=0 while k<#{width} { assert_equal(original[k],0) if k>=#{count} { assert_equal(final[k],0) } k+=1 } print(\"NESTED DICTIONARY PAYLOAD PASS\")\n"
 File.write(dir+'/owner.kujo',owner);File.write(dir+'/main.kujo',main);[dir+'/owner.kujo',dir+'/main.kujo'].each{|p|r[:sources][p]={sha256:sha.call(p),source:File.read(p)}}
 meta={shape:shape,form:form,width:width,snapshot:snapshot,calls:calls,path:dir+'/main.kujo'}
 %w[vm jit].each do |mode|
  argv=[prior+'/task-allocation-probe',mode,meta[:path]];out,err,s=Open3.capture3(*argv);m=err.match(/requests=(\d+) requested_bytes=(\d+)/);raise out+err unless s.success?&&m&&out=="NESTED DICTIONARY PAYLOAD PASS\n"
  r[:rows]<<meta.merge(mode:mode,argv:argv,stdout:out,stderr:err,exit:s.exitstatus,requests:m[1].to_i,bytes:m[2].to_i)
 end
 %w[vm interpreter jit].each do |mode|
  argv=[prior+'/candidate-kujo','run',meta[:path],'--untrusted','--scheduler-no-timeout']+(mode=='vm' ? [] : ['--'+mode]);out,err,s=Open3.capture3(*argv);raise out+err unless s.success?&&out=="NESTED DICTIONARY PAYLOAD PASS\n"
  r[:semantics]<<meta.merge(mode:mode,argv:argv,stdout:out,stderr:err,exit:s.exitstatus)
 end
 save.call
end
raise 'coverage' unless r[:rows].size==144&&r[:semantics].size==216
r[:identities].each{|p,h|raise 'identity' unless sha.call(p)==h};r[:status]='measured';save.call;puts '144allocation/216semantic nested dictionary payload baseline observations'

verify.rb.source:
require 'json'; require 'digest'
o=File.expand_path(__dir__); r=JSON.parse(File.read(o+'/report.json')); raise 'incomplete' unless r['status']=='measured' && r['runtime']=='8ab7c6a'
r['identities'].each{|p,h|raise "identity #{p}" unless Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest==h}
r['sources'].each{|p,v|raise "source #{p}" unless File.read(p)==v['source'] && Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest==v['sha256']}
keys=%w[shape form width snapshot calls mode]
base=%w[dict struct deep-dict].product(%w[structs strings],[8,2048],%w[once fresh],[1,8,16])
{'rows'=>%w[vm jit],'semantics'=>%w[vm interpreter jit]}.each do |group,modes|
 expected=base.flat_map{|v|modes.map{|m|v+[m]}}.sort
 raise "matrix #{group}" unless r[group].map{|v|keys.map{|k|v[k]}}.sort==expected
 r[group].each do |v|
  raise 'result' unless v['exit']==0 && v['stdout']=="NESTED DICTIONARY PAYLOAD PASS\n" && r['sources'].key?(v['path'])
  if group=='rows'
   m=v['stderr'].match(/requests=(\d+) requested_bytes=(\d+)/)
   raise 'counter' unless m && m[1].to_i==v['requests'] && m[2].to_i==v['bytes']
   raise 'argv' unless v['argv']==[r['identities'].keys.find{|p|p.end_with?('/task-allocation-probe')},v['mode'],v['path']]
  else
   a=[r['identities'].keys.find{|p|p.end_with?('/candidate-kujo')},'run',v['path'],'--untrusted','--scheduler-no-timeout']+(v['mode']=='vm' ? [] : ['--'+v['mode']])
   raise 'argv' unless v['argv']==a
  end
 end
end
slopes=[]
%w[dict struct deep-dict].product(%w[structs strings],%w[vm jit],[[1,8],[8,16]]).each do |shape,form,mode,interval|
 values=[8,2048].map do |width|
  rows=interval.map{|calls|r['rows'].find{|v|v.values_at('shape','form','mode','width','snapshot','calls')==[shape,form,mode,width,'once',calls]}}
  Rational(rows[1]['bytes']-rows[0]['bytes'],interval[1]-interval[0])
 end
 slopes<<{shape:shape,form:form,mode:mode,interval:interval,width_bytes_per_call:(values[1]-values[0]).to_s}
end
receipt={status:'verified',report_sha256:Digest::SHA256.file(o+'/report.json').hexdigest,allocation_rows:144,semantic_rows:216,once_width_slopes:slopes}
File.write(o+'/verified.json',JSON.pretty_generate(receipt));puts JSON.generate(receipt)
